prompts.name: sylph-fine-v3
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite. User wants classic MapleStory art matching the CENTER PINK BEAN in the NPC catalog reference: fine delicate sprite outlines, rounded shaded forms, many tiny neat pixels, smooth compact color ramps, NO giant chunky 8-bit square pixels. At the small in-game scale it should match native MapleStory NPC sprites. Draw a sleeping sealed companion enclosed in a translucent pale blue ice cocoon. Closed eyes, head tilted slightly, exact character identity/costume from original reference; simple glassy ice, soft cyan edges and subtle highlights, 2 thin crossed magic bands. Full body and entire ice visible, centered with 10% transparent margin. No rings or orbit trails baked in, those are separately animated. No text, scenery, pedestal, giant crystals or ornate illustration. Crisp miniature 2D game sprite with refined fine sprite detailing comparable to Pink Bean, natural rounded edges rather than visibly enlarged pixel blocks. True transparent RGBA. Character: Sylph, original reference Image 1. Preserve spiky silver/lilac hair, pale skin, blue/violet eyes (closed sleeping), black-and-white outfit with blue trims, exact native chibi proportions. Image 2 is style reference only: match center Pink Bean refined pixel density.

prompts.name: orbit-light
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D MapleStory spell particle, single tiny light bead for repeated comet orbit trail. Center a small white glowing core with cyan and pale blue aura, soft delicate falloff to complete transparency, circular compact mark, fills only middle 35% of canvas with wide transparent padding. Refined MapleStory native skill-effect art, fine pixel-compatible detailing and subtle smooth glow like magic in the NPC catalog reference. No giant chunky blocks, no black outline, no star points, no tail, no ring, no character, no text or background. True RGBA transparent. The small round light will be repeated along elliptical paths with fading alpha to form comet tails at runtime.
